src: Mass marriage: In which several men marry several women at once and the man thus becomes a husband for all females and a woman a wife for all males, this type of marriage system almost does not exist at present or at least does not exist explicitly even among primitive societies although it is certain that there is a marriage system that allows the wife to be lent on conditions set by society as is the case among the Comanche tribes where the brothers of the husband share in his wife on certain occasions although this does not prevent the wife from being punished and considered adulterous if she allows herself to have a relationship that goes beyond this framework as is the case with the Esquima tribes.

src: She used the word Sham to refer to the city of Damascus. It is one of its many names and names synonymous with it over the centuries. src: Abdul Hadi, a former journalist, broadcaster and editor in the Arab section of the Voice of Germany, was born in 1939 in the city of Jenin in Palestine where he finished high school and left the Arab country at the end of the 1950s for Federal Germany to complete his studies at a German university. src: Muhammad Ali al-Ailuni left the Turkish army and headed secretly to southern Jordan where he joined the Arab army led by Prince Faisal bin Hussein. src: The World Assembly of Muslim Youth is an independent international Islamic organization and non-governmental organization member of the United Nations. src: The Toshki Low is a natural low south of the Western Sahara in Egypt that has been used to drain the excess water of Lake Nasser in order to protect the high dam from high flooding. src: A horse is a piece of small chess pieces embodied in a horse, represented by a horse's head, neck, and theoretical value of three pawns.
